mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_call WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM chat_call WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND initiator_id=#{actorId} AND client_request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM chat_call WHERE active_conversation_id=#{conversationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT call_id,user_id,member_id,display_name,state,website_scope,media_identity,last_seen_at, (last_seen_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 35 SECOND) AS lease_fresh FROM chat_call_participant WHERE call_id=#{callId} ORDER BY user_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_call_participant(call_id,user_id,member_id,display_name,state,website_scope,media_identity,last_seen_at) VALUES(#{row.callId},#{row.userId},#{row.memberId},#{row.displayName},#{row.state},#{row.websiteScope},#{row.mediaIdentity}, CASE WHEN #{row.state}='ACCEPTED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END)
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_call_participant SET state='ACCEPTED',website_scope=#{scope},media_identity=#{identity},last_seen_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE call_id=#{callId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND state='INVITED'
UPDATE chat_call_participant SET state=#{state},website_scope=NULL WHERE call_id=#{callId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND state=#{expected}

UPDATE chat_call SET state=#{state},end_reason=#{reason},version=version+1, ended_at=CASE WHEN #{state}='ENDED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state IN ('RINGING','ACTIVE') AND version < 9223372036854775807
UPDATE chat_call_participant SET state=CASE WHEN state='INVITED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'LEFT' END,website_scope=NULL WHERE call_id=#{callId} AND state IN ('INVITED','ACCEPTED')
mapper.select: SELECT call_id,actor_id,request_id,command_type,request_hash,applied_version FROM chat_call_command WHERE call_id=#{callId} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_call_participant SET last_seen_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE call_id=#{callId} AND user_id=#{actorId} AND state='ACCEPTED' AND website_scope=#{scope} AND last_seen_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 35 SECOND
mapper.select: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_call_participant p JOIN chat_call c ON c.id=p.call_id LEFT JOIN chat_member m ON m.conversation_id=c.conversation_id AND m.user_id=p.user_id LEFT JOIN chat_contact_lock b ON b.low_id=LEAST(c.initiator_id,p.user_id) AND b.high_id=GREATEST(c.initiator_id,p.user_id) WHERE p.call_id=#{callId} AND p.state IN ('INVITED','ACCEPTED') AND (m.id IS NULL OR m.id <> p.member_id OR COALESCE(b.low_blocks_high,0)=1 OR COALESCE(b.high_blocks_low,0)=1))
SELECT id FROM chat_call WHERE state IN ('RINGING','ACTIVE') AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
